GeoReference.description:
Anchors the local frame on the earth.

The local point ``(0, 0)`` is at ``(origin_lat, origin_lon)``. The local axes are the east
and north axes rotated counter-clockwise by ``rotation_deg``: a local point ``(x, y)`` lies
``east = x cos(r) - y sin(r)`` and ``north = x sin(r) + y cos(r)`` metres from the origin.

PermissionDef.description:
A permission a module defines, e.g. ``mower.control``.

Keys that have a relation in the authorization model are checked per object in OpenFGA.
Other keys are coarse, account-wide permissions carried in the access token (``perms``) and
checked with ``require_permission``. ``implied_by`` lets such a key follow an existing one:
whoever holds every listed key on the whole account also holds this key.

implied_by.description: Keys that imply this one when held on the whole account (e.g. `device_gateway.view` implied by `mower.view`).
implied_by.title: Implied By

SpotNativeJob.description:
The plan expressed as a native job of the mower: whole map areas and one pattern.

Present only when the chain is exactly one pattern the mower may run by itself (``stripes``,
``diagonal``, ``checkerboard``, ``edge_only``, or ``border_fill`` with one of them) on map
areas, so a mower without ``custom_paths`` can still execute it as an ordinary
``StartMow(area_ids, pattern)``.

reverse.description: Drive the polyline backwards (negative linear speed, the mower faces against the direction of travel); always with the blades off (ADR 0043).

TurnStyle.description:
How a spot run turns at the end of a lane (ADR 0043).

``in_place``: the mower rotates on the spot (fast, but an all-wheel-drive mower scuffs the
turf). ``arc``: a forward U-turn with a radius of at least half the lane spacing, or a bulb
turn over the neighbouring lane when the spacing is narrower than the turning radius.
``multi_point``: a three-point turn (forward arc, reverse arc with the blades off, forward
arc); needs a drive link that can reverse (``MowerCapabilities.drive_reverse``).
TurnStyle.title: TurnStyle

post.description:
The plan ready to start: the ``SpotMowPlan`` with its hash and the ``start_mow``
command for Fleet. Nothing is stored; the same request gives the same hash. Needs
``can_control`` on the mower (Fleet checks it again when the command arrives).

Compute and validate a plan and show it: segments, duration, area, warnings, and how
the mower can run it. Needs ``can_view`` on the mower (404 when invisible).

delete.description: Delete a saved chain; needs ``can_control`` on the account.

put.description: Create (201) or replace (200) a saved chain; needs ``can_control`` on the account.
